Evan K: Heads-up: we just received a dispute from Sentinel Labs for INV-SNT-2026-77, amount $4,350. Claim: 'unauthorized transaction'. Stripe dispute id dp_1MnbX2. Deadline 7 days. @Ravi can you take point?
Maya S: Which billing project / api key? Need card last4 and billing email before we pull logs.
Evan K: billing_project: sentinel-prod, card last4 3782, billing email billing@sentinel.example, billed window 2026-08-02..2026-08-08.
Ravi (Payments): I'll gather usage CSV and key lifecycle. Also check prior risk flags. Any notes from CS?
Jordan (CS): Customer says they never created the volume. They provided a screenshot of their internal dashboard showing near-zero inbound traffic during 08-05. I'm sending onboarding thread link.
Stripe-Bot: dispute.created id=dp_1MnbX2 amount=4350 currency=USD reason=unauthorized created=1715183980
Ravi (Payments): Quick request: pull request_logs for 2026-08-02..2026-08-08 for billing_project=sentinel-prod. Need columns: request_id, api_key_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, ip_address, ts. Prefer CSV upload to ticket. Example SQL: 
```
SELECT request_id, api_key_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, ip_address, ts
FROM request_logs
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08' AND billing_project = 'sentinel-prod';
```
Jordan (CS): I checked onboarding: key created by "olivia.s@sentinel.example" on 2026-07-28 via console. They confirm they didn't share credentials.
Evan K: If key was leaked, we should show timeline: key creation -> spike -> key disabled. Provide IP geos and any user-agent anomalies.
Ravi (Payments): Summary from logs: heavy usage concentrated 2026-08-05 02:10..05:30 UTC, ~820k tokens, single api_key key_sntXYZ, originating from two IPs: 3.211.45.66 (us-east1) and 103.21.244.0 (APAC cloud). User-agent mostly "redwood-sdk/1.4" but 12k calls with "curl/7.68.0". Uploaded CSV to ticket FT-4022.
Jordan (CS): We placed account in billing-review and disabled write keys at 2026-08-05 06:10 UTC. Notified customer.
AutoOps: Action logged: billing_hold set by Jordan at ts=1715188000; write keys disabled.
Maya S: For the dispute bundle we need: invoice PDF, usage CSV, key creation event, support thread where customer denies auth, hold action log, and geo/IP lookup. Ravi, please add a short bullet summary for Stripe.
Ravi (Payments): Will do. Note: no prior fraud chargebacks. Key creation IP matches corporate IP. Sudden calls from APAC IPs after 08-04 look anomalous. I'll run a reverse DNS and ASN lookup and include results.
Stripe-Bot: dispute.updated id=dp_1MnbX2 status=needs_response by=merchant deadline=1715798800
Evan K: Draft reply plan: 1) provide timeline + artifacts, 2) show we disabled keys and held account, 3) include support ticket showing customer denies auth, 4) ask Stripe for consideration of key compromise evidence. I'll draft and share for review before submission.
Jordan (CS): Customer requested interim refund; Legal says wait for dispute outcome but offer goodwill credit if Stripe rules for customer.
Ravi (Payments): Evidence bundle ready. Will submit via Stripe API and paste submission id here.
Evan K: Thanks all. Keep updates in FT-4022.
